notes.title: Small update to the demo
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are patch notes for the latest demo. This also renames the save file which will reset your progress.

[*] Save file renamed
[*] Better Health bar UI
[*] Enemies drop dirt and flowers can be only planted to the dirt
[*] Pop up when near shopkeeper
[*] Mushy Zombie and Walking Plant sizes adjusted
[*] Tutorial gif for all flowers
[*] Flower effect sped up
[*] Enemies spawn farther to the sides
[/list]

notes.title: Mushy Score Demo
notes.content:
[h2]What is Mushy Score?[/h2]
Mushy Score is a 2D platformer where you fight endless waves of enemies for a high score. 
Use the collectables to boost the power of your character and improve your future runs. Use flowers as power ups or let them fight enemies for you.

[h2]The Demo[/h2]
The goal of the demo is to show a slice of the game and get feedback to improve the development. In the demo you got the town and two levels, the forest and the swamp. There is multiple different enemies and two bosses. Can you survive long enough to defeat 250 enemies?

[h2]Upcoming[/h2]
I will update the demo during the Steam Next Fest and I will also leave the demo available after the festival. Next update will involve polishing such as better particle effects and animations. I will also improve how the flower power ups are used and make them more interactive.

Hopefully you will enjoy the demo and the Steam Next Fest!
